mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_GRADE MG ON M.member_id = MG.member_id
AND ( M.member_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR M.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR M.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND MG.grade_name = #{searchGrade}
AND M.status = #{searchStatus}
AND M.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND M.created_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND M.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND M.created_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND M.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND M.created_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM( CASE WHEN created_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS todayCount, SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS activeCount, SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'INACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS dormantCount, SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS withdrawnCount FROM MEMBER

SELECT M.*, MG.grade_name AS memberGrade, COALESCE(O.total_payment, 0) AS totalPayment, COALESCE(O.order_count, 0) AS orderCount FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_GRADE MG ON M.member_id = MG.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, SUM(final_amount) AS total_payment, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ORDERS GROUP BY member_id ) O ON M.member_id = O.member_id WHERE M.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBERSHIP_GRADE ( grade_code, grade_name, min_purchase_amount, created_at, member_id ) VALUES ( CASE #{memberGrade} WHEN 'BRONZE' THEN '1' WHEN 'SILVER' THEN '2' WHEN 'GOLD' THEN '3' WHEN 'VIP' THEN '4' END, #{memberGrade}, 0, NOW(), #{memberId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN'
UPDATE MEMBER SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status != 'WITHDRAWN'
UPDATE MEMBER SET member_name = #{memberName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId, member_id AS memberId, admin_id AS adminId, NULL AS adminName, change_type AS changeType, change_field AS changeField, before_value AS beforeValue, after_value AS afterValue, reason, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM MEMBER_HISTORY WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, history_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_HISTORY ( member_id, admin_id, change_type, change_field, before_value, after_value, reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{adminId}, #{changeType}, #{changeField}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{reason}, NOW() )
